run_scannet_preprocessing: run the ScannetPreprocessing CLI to preprocess ScanNet dataset files into processed format
create_scannet_preprocessor: create a ScannetPreprocessing instance with custom data_dir, save_dir, modes, and scannet200 flag
process_scannet_file: process a single ScanNet PLY file into a numpy array with coordinates, features, and labels
fix_scannet_label_bugs: fix known bugs in ScanNet200 segmentation labels for specific scenes and sub-scenes
parse_scene_subscene: parse a ScanNet filename to extract scene and sub_scene integer identifiers
